NFL DFS Running Back Rankings: Week 12 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Sunday, November 29 · 9 games · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of November 24, 10:36 PM ET

Bijan Robinson is the top-projected running back on the Week 12 DraftKings main slate at 22.4 DraftKings points for $7,700, at Minnesota. Christian McCaffrey (17.6, $8,600) and Cam Skattebo (16.9, $6,100) are next.

Bijan Robinson is also the top value at the position: 2.91 projected points per $1,000.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the November 24, 10:36 PM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are published.

Running backs to know in Week 12

Bijan Robinson, ATL at MIN ($7,700)

Bijan Robinson carries the highest SPAGS model projection at the position, 22.4 DraftKings points at $7,700, the 3rd-highest on the entire main slate. That is 4.8 points clear of Christian McCaffrey. The model gives him 20.3 carries and 4.7 targets. The salary works out to 2.91 projected points per $1,000, 1st of 19 at the position. Across 50,000 simulations Robinson averaged 22.4 points with a simulated floor of 10.4 and a ceiling of 40.2, and he holds 37% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Atlanta is a 7-point underdog on the road against Minnesota, with an implied team total of 17.25 in a game totaled at 41.5.

Christian McCaffrey, SF vs SEA ($8,600)

Christian McCaffrey projects 2nd at the position with 17.6 DraftKings points at $8,600. The model gives him 12.9 carries and 4.6 targets. The salary works out to 2.05 projected points per $1,000, 14th of 19 at the position. Across 50,000 simulations McCaffrey averaged 17.7 points with a simulated floor of 7.6 and a ceiling of 32.8, and he holds 7% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. San Francisco is a 3.5-point favorite at home against Seattle, with an implied team total of 24.5 in a game totaled at 45.5.

Cam Skattebo, NYG at IND ($6,100)

Cam Skattebo projects 3rd at the position with 16.9 DraftKings points at $6,100. The model gives him 18.8 carries and 2.6 targets. The salary works out to 2.77 projected points per $1,000, 2nd of 19 at the position. Across 50,000 simulations Skattebo averaged 16.9 points with a simulated floor of 7.2 and a ceiling of 33.0, and he holds 32% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. The Giants are a 6.5-point favorite on the road against Indianapolis, with an implied team total of 24 in a game totaled at 41.5.

Value: Ollie Gordon II, MIA vs NYJ ($5,800)

Ollie Gordon II projects for 15.1 DraftKings points at $5,800, which works out to 2.60 points per $1,000 of salary. That is the best rate of any player priced in the cheaper half of the 19 running backs the model projects for 9 or more points. The model gives him 15.4 carries and 1.9 targets. Across 50,000 simulations Gordon averaged 15.0 points with a simulated floor of 5.3 and a ceiling of 31.1, and he holds 20% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Miami is a 3.5-point underdog at home against the Jets, with an implied team total of 18.5 in a game totaled at 40.5.
